project.purpose: Structured record of confirmed rules, design explanations, superseded rules, and open questions.

core_principles: Face-to-face discussion is the main activity.
Physical cards and a physical table/board are part of the experience.
Phones handle secret information, hidden actions, validation, and rule resolution.
The game has no ordinary private messaging/chat.
Standard Hack and optional Private Link are the only private interactions.
The base game must work without Original Powers.
The game is round-based and has no match-wide countdown.

elimination_reveal.timing: At the next public phase after elimination
elimination_reveal.note: Alien faction effectively reveals the Alien role because Alien is unique.

turn_order.method: Randomized at the start of each normal round

sequence: Optional Standard Hack immediately after speaking
Main Action and/or Shot if permitted
player_turn.formula: Talk -> Standard Hack -> Action / Shot -> Next Player
notes: Main Action, Shot, and Standard Hack are independent opportunities; they are not collapsed into one total action.
Standard Hack cannot be postponed until the end of the turn.
Exact duration of a player turn is not finalized in v2.1.

exceptions: Cracker may self-rescue while Injured without Emergency Override.
Emergency Override may allow one otherwise-valid role Main Action while Injured.

assignment_rules.Healthy_non_captain: May occupy Room A or Room B
assignment_rules.Injured: Moves to Hospital at the end of the round

movement.room_a_room_b: Active/Healthy non-Captain players may move between Room A and Room B

same_location_target_rule.rule: A direct action targeting another player requires actor and target to be in the same location unless an explicit exception says otherwise.

special_access.Cracker: Has access to Hospital for Rescue.
special_access.Command Room: Protected from all actions and shots; players inside cannot be targeted by those effects.

election_method.tie_rule: Immediate runoff among tied candidates; repeat until one candidate has the highest vote.

loss_of_role: Captain immediately loses Captain status if Injured.
Captain immediately loses Captain status if Jailed.
Captain obviously loses the role if Eliminated.
captain.replacement_timing: No mid-round replacement; if a new Captain is needed, election is held at the start of the next round.
captain.multiple_events_same_round: Only one Captain election is needed at the start of the next round.
captain.jail_release_authority: Only the current Captain may initiate the match-wide jail release request.

jail_voting.normal_vote_effect: Successful vote sends a player to Jail; it does not deal damage or eliminate.
success_conditions: There must be a unique top-vote getter.
The top-vote getter must receive at least 50% of all players eligible to vote at the start of voting.
If tied for top votes, nobody is jailed.
jail_voting.denominator: All eligible voters, not votes cast.

release_request.timing: At the start of the normal-round voting phase
release_request.threshold: At least 50% of all eligible voters; exactly 50% is sufficient.

standard_hack.request_timing: Only during the player's own turn, immediately after public speaking.
standard_hack.content_embargo: Both participants may not discuss or reveal the content of that Hack during the same round. They may discuss it starting next round.
standard_hack.note: Because Round 5 is final, a Hack performed in Round 5 currently cannot be discussed before the game ends unless this rule is changed.

Insider.ability: At game start receives the unordered set of three players who are Undercover, Alien, and Cracker, without knowing which is which.

Cracker.main_action: Targets one player; at end of round, if target is Injured, target becomes Healthy.
Cracker.injured_rescue_others: Requires Emergency Override if that optional power is available and used.

Supplier.main_action: Selects two distinct recipients; each receives one ordinary weapon usable in Round 4 or 5.

protection.main_action: Targets a Healthy or Injured player.
protection.activation: Automatically becomes active at the start of the next normal round.

Hacker.starting_knowledge: Knows only who Undercover is and therefore knows that player's number is excluded from Code.

scan.wrong_faction_guess: Scan fails, reveals no Code information, and the round's Scan is consumed.
scan.correct_faction_guess: App reveals only whether the target's number is in the unordered Code set.

Alien.ordinary_shot_identification_rule: Must correctly identify one Red player, then shoot a different player.

identification_rule.Blue_shooter: Must correctly identify one Red player.
identification_rule.Red_shooter: Must correctly identify one Blue player.
identification_rule.Alien_shooter: Must correctly identify one Red player.

validation_order: If wrong: Shot fails, attack resources are consumed, target Protection is not consumed, and Silencer does not trigger.
If correct: attack becomes valid; then Protection / Silencer / damage resolution applies.

protection.activation: Undercover Protection activates automatically at the start of the next normal round.
protection.on_block: The effect is canceled and both the Protection instance and all attack resources are consumed.

optional_original_power_pack.deal_rule_if_enabled: All 8 players receive exactly one Original Power card before Role cards; duplicate powers are allowed.

Heavy_Shot.effect: Automatically modifies the first valid ordinary-shot attempt into 2 damage.
Heavy_Shot.successful_unblocked_effect: Eliminates a Healthy or Injured target through 2 damage unless Reinforced Systems prevents damage-caused elimination.
Heavy_Shot.protection_interaction: Protection blocks it; weapon + Heavy Shot + Protection are consumed.
Heavy_Shot.wrong_identification: Weapon and Heavy Shot are consumed; no damage.

Reinforced_Systems.effect: Prevents an elimination caused by DAMAGE; target remains Injured.
Reinforced_Systems.final_collision_interaction: Final Collision is canceled; neither player changes status; both Final Collision and Reinforced Systems are consumed.

Final_Collision.trigger: Automatically becomes ready when owner becomes Injured.
Final_Collision.availability: From owner's next own turn while still Injured.
Final_Collision.effect: Owner may choose another player and directly eliminate both self and target.
Final_Collision.protection_interaction: If target Protection blocks it, neither player changes status; both Collision and Protection are consumed.
Final_Collision.reinforced_interaction: If target has unused Reinforced Systems, neither player changes status; both Collision and Reinforced are consumed.

Silencer.trigger: First valid Ordinary or Heavy Shot targeting owner.

Private_Link.effect: Schedules one separate 30-second private interaction between the same two players at the start of the next normal round.

Emergency_Override.effect: Allows one otherwise-valid role Main Action despite Injury restrictions.

power_formula.Blue_Power: Number of Healthy Blue players + 1 if Alien is Healthy

victory.minimum_health_requirement: Every team victory requires at least one Healthy member of that actual team. Alien does not satisfy the Healthy Blue requirement.
Blue: All Red players are Eliminated AND at least one Healthy Blue exists.
At end of Round 5, Hacker has NOT submitted the correct Code, at least one Healthy Blue exists, and Blue Power > Red Power.
Red: All Blue players are Eliminated AND at least one Healthy Red exists.
Hacker submits the correct Code by end of Round 5 AND at least one Healthy Red exists. No Power comparison is required for this Code victory.
Alien: If Blue wins and Alien is not Eliminated, Alien also wins.
If Blue and Red are eliminated simultaneously and Alien is not Eliminated, Alien wins solo.
If Red wins, Alien does not win.

confirmed_removed_or_superseded_rules.rule: Ordered Code / code positions / Position Test
confirmed_removed_or_superseded_rules.replacement: Code is an unordered set of 4 distinct player numbers.
Only Standard Hack and optional Private Link are private interactions.

confirmed_removed_or_superseded_rules.rule: Old Active / Disabled / Critical / Destroyed health model
confirmed_removed_or_superseded_rules.replacement: Healthy / Injured / Eliminated, with Jail as a separate overlay.
Vote sends a player to Jail.

confirmed_removed_or_superseded_rules.rule: Hacker bonus scan / position test / steal hack / scan transfer

open_questions.question: Exactly when may a Healthy non-Captain player move between Room A and Room B?
How many Room A <-> Room B moves are allowed per round?
Exact duration of public speaking / player turn and Standard Hack timer in v2.1.
Finalize exact ordering of Jail vote, registered actions, Disabler, damage, Rescue, Supplier distribution, elimination/reveal, victory check, and Captain-election flagging.
If an action was validly registered and the actor later becomes Injured, Jailed, or Eliminated in the same round, does it still resolve?
Can multiple Protection instances stack on the same player, and can Undercover target self?
Exact point in Round 5 when Hacker may submit, and whether there is exactly one attempt.
If Code is not correct by end of Round 5 but Blue Power is not greater than Red Power and neither elimination victory applies, is the result No Winner / Draw or is there a tie-breaker?
What happens if a Captain election is required but no eligible candidate exists?
Because there is no Round 6, should Standard Hack content from Round 5 remain undisclosed until game end, or should Round 5 use a special rule?

app_should_handle: Standard Hack eligibility and round cap
Hacker Scan validation and Code-membership result
Captain status and Command Room immunity
